app.title: Show HN: Reactor Atlas
app.author: fedecaccia
app.description: A lightweight message queue built in Rust inspired by Reactor patterns, usable via CLI and HTTP API.
proposed_tests: publish 1000 messages to a test topic and measure publish latency
consume the same 1000 messages and verify order and latency
compare publish/consume latency to Redis Streams on same hardware
